notes.title: Accessibility Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a toggle 'Cursor Lock' to the Settings menu. You can toggle this off to play the game with the cursor visible and able to move around freely. This is to support software that maps mouse movements to keys
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch
notes.notes:
Thanks to everybody playing the game!

Here are a couple of day 1 changes:
[list]
[*] Added a sign for 'Hub Isle' to convey that the island you start on is a hub to reach other locations
[*] Made the beams of light for animals very tall for the first two levels (beagle and pig). This is to make the start of the game easier
[/list]
